Your neighbors, and your team.

We are Vlad and Anastasiia, a husband and wife Realtor team at Keller Williams. Since 2020 we have closed more than 130 homes, and most of our clients found us the same way: someone they trust passed along our number.

We live in Windermere and work the streets between the lakes and downtown Winter Garden every day. Vlad handles pricing, negotiation and the numbers. Anastasiia prepares and stages homes so they show at their best. You get both of us on every move, at every price point.
